title: Week in Orbit
summary: SpaceX's IPO has sent ripples through the industry, with shares soaring nearly 20% and Musk's net worth hitting new heights. Meanwhile, the space defense sector is seeing increased budget allocations and strategic partnerships, even as some projects stumble.

themes.title: SpaceX's IPO Surge
themes.body: The historic IPO has not only boosted SpaceX's valuation but also reignited interest in the defense-tech market. Investors are clearly betting on a future where space ventures are as lucrative as they are ambitious.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Space Resilience
themes.body: The recent FY27 budget markup adds $1.4 billion for space resilience, signaling a growing commitment to safeguarding U.S. interests in orbit. This increase may reflect both geopolitical tensions and the increasing complexity of space operations.

themes.title: Partnerships in Tactical SDA
themes.body: Anduril and L3Harris are teaming up for a tactical SDA constellation bid, highlighting a trend towards collaboration among defense contractors. Such partnerships may be essential as the industry grapples with the challenges of modern warfare in space.

themes.title: Hypersonic Testing Delays
themes.body: The continued delays in hypersonic glide-vehicle tests raise questions about the U.S. military's readiness in this critical area. As other nations advance, the pressure is on to get these capabilities operational sooner rather than later.
